🔭 Scope.what: The question, goal, and boundaries of this work.
🔭 Scope.outcome: A clear statement of what is included, excluded, and considered complete.
🔭 Scope.example: Set the boundaries and acceptance criteria for producing {result}.
🔭 Scope.layout_detail: One goal statement, followed by concise boundaries and a completion condition.

🧩 Structure.what: How the work is organized into parts.
🧩 Structure.outcome: A map of the parts, their roles, and how they fit together.
🧩 Structure.example: Map the steps needed to produce {result} and show where {evidence} is checked.
🧩 Structure.layout_detail: Show parts and their relationships as a tree or flow; selecting a part opens its details.

🔗 Dependencies.what: See what each Topic or work item needs, who owns it, and the condition that allows work to continue.

📈 Progress.what: Where the work stands against its completion criteria.
📈 Progress.outcome: Visible completed, active, and remaining work, backed by current records.
📈 Progress.example: Show whether {result} is planned, in progress, or checked against {evidence}.
📈 Progress.layout_detail: List work items with status words on the left; show progress, completion criteria, and records on the right.

🚧 Blockers.what: The unresolved issues preventing the next step or completion.
🚧 Blockers.outcome: Each obstacle, its owner, and the condition needed to remove it.
🚧 Blockers.example: Show missing inputs or failed checks that prevent acceptance of {result}.
🚧 Blockers.layout_detail: List obstacles on the left; show the selected obstacle, owner, impact, and resolution condition on the right.

➡️ Next Steps.what: The next actions that move the work forward.
➡️ Next Steps.outcome: An ordered set of concrete actions with owners and completion criteria.
➡️ Next Steps.example: Name the next action needed to produce or verify {result}.
➡️ Next Steps.layout_detail: Show each action with its owner, state, and completion condition in execution order.

📦 Results.what: The outputs and answers this work has produced.
📦 Results.outcome: Readable results with links to the actual deliverables and their current state.
📦 Results.layout_detail: List outputs on the left; show the selected result or embedded artifact on the right, with an Open action.

🧾 Evidence.what: The sources and checks supporting the results.
🧾 Evidence.outcome: Traceable support for each important result, including verification status.
🧾 Evidence.example: Link {evidence} to the claims made about {result}.
🧾 Evidence.layout_detail: List supporting sources or checks on the left; show the evidence, supported claim, and verification state on the right.

⚠️ Limitations.what: Where the results are uncertain, incomplete, or not applicable.
⚠️ Limitations.outcome: Clear boundaries on interpretation and use, with the remaining gaps.
⚠️ Limitations.example: Explain which conditions {evidence} does not cover and how that limits {result}.
⚠️ Limitations.layout_detail: One limitation per item, stating the affected result and the consequence for interpretation or use.

📚 Things to Know.what: Find the terms, assumptions, and references needed here.

☑️ Checklist.what: Track required checks and actions. Delivery Acceptance refers to these checks instead of duplicating them.

🧰 Skills.what: Find the skills that help maintain this view.
🧰 Skills.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Skill Details

📋 Job Type × View Button.what: Compare Job types, their views, and their content.

📋 Task Type × View Button.what: Compare Task types, their views, and their content.

🖥️ The page, live.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Live Page

🎬 The walk.what: Watch an example page in use. Pause, step, or replay.

🖥️ The pages, live.what: Select a UI type on the left and try its example page on the right.
🖥️ The pages, live.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Live Page

🎬 Walkthroughs.what: Select an example and watch its walkthrough.
🎬 Walkthroughs.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Walkthrough Player

✉️ Messages.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Message List

⏳ Next move.what: See who acts next in each open Job and what needs to happen.
⏳ Next move.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Action Details

📚 Papers.what: Read each paper’s findings, source links, and verification state.
📚 Papers.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Paper Details

📖 Evidence Bib.what: Bibliography entries built by the Job’s Discovery Tasks; present only when the source bibliography exists.

🧾 Synthesis.what: Read the conclusions drawn across the sources.

🎯 Goal.what: The intended outcome and boundaries of this work.

📋 Requirements.what: What must be true, who requested it, and how completion will be checked. Accepted feedback links back here.

🧩 Topics.what: Choose a Topic on the left; inspect its related Block, Jobs, Tasks, and Runs on the right. Topics reuse the MindMap and link existing work.
🧩 Topics.layout: Left Tabs · Right Content → Expandable B–J–T–R

📦 Deliverables.what: Open the actual outputs with their versions. Feedback refers to the version that was reviewed.

✅ Acceptance.what: Check each deliverable against its requirements and recorded acceptance. Reuse the existing checks.

📖 Usage.what: How to use the selected deliverable, including its known constraints.

💡 Design Findings.what: Read what the design reviews and trials taught us. Working UI packages live in Delivery.

🧾 Review Evidence.what: Inspect the walkthroughs, checks, and observations supporting a design finding.

🤝 Agreements.what: Read the agreements reached through coordination, linked to their source discussions.

💬 Open Differences.what: See where participants still disagree and what would resolve the difference.

🧾 Communication Evidence.what: Read the messages and meeting records supporting an agreement or finding.

⚠️ Evidence Gaps.what: See questions the collected sources cannot yet answer, and why.

💡 Conclusions.what: Read what this work established and how far the conclusion applies.

🕒 Timeline.what: Dated history for this page: changes, Runs, feedback, decisions, and delivery records. Open an event’s source; undated items stay in their own sections.

🧭 Work Structure.what: Read the shared live view structure and the feedback-to-design loop.

📌 Headlines.what: Read the latest result from each Task.

📌 Latest Result.what: Read the latest available Run result.

🗂️ Tables.what: Read tables returned by the latest Run.

🙋 Interactions.what: Questions and feedback for the selected topic.
🙋 Interactions.outcome: Answers linked to their original topic.
🙋 Interactions.layout_detail: Topics on the left; questions and their form on the right.

⚖️ Decisions.layout_detail: Topics on the left; source decision records on the right.

📁 Files.what: Related directories grouped by Workspace, Blocks, Code, Tools · Skills and Tools · UI.
📁 Files.outcome: Open, preview or download the original file.
📁 Files.layout: Left Folder Types · Right Folder Tree
📁 Files.layout_detail: Select a type, expand folders in the tree, and click a file to inspect it in a pop-out. Closing it keeps your place in the tree; Runs stay inside Blocks.

🧩 Job.what: One group of Tasks sharing inputs, code or a question. Data preparation, model training and software development use the same Job UI; they are use cases, not separate UI types.

🤝 Collaboration Job.what: A line of collaboration with messages, meetings, steps and a recorded next move. Tasks appear only when present.
🤝 Collaboration Job.example: cowork_focus.job_status and parts. The reference People Job has its own row.

🔎 Inquiry Job.what: A group of Discovery Tasks. Inquiry subjects differ; the Job renderer is shared. Findings add source papers, bibliography and synthesis when present.

🧱 Tasks.what: Actual child Tasks, each with its recorded state and latest Run result. Expand a Task to inspect its Runs. Omitted when no Tasks exist.

🧩 View BJTR.what: Choose an existing Topic to inspect its linked Tasks and Runs with Block context. This does not create new work or infer a type from a title.

📇 Who to ask, by role.what: The reference People Job lists people and roles. It has no next-move workflow.

🗓️ Timeline.what: Dated collaboration entries from this Job. This existing Status section is distinct from the shared Timeline and has not yet been consolidated.

📝 Steps.what: The existing steps in this Job’s CHECKLIST.md, with their recorded completion marks. These are not the proposed evidence/reviewer Checklist workflow.

📝 Checklist.what: Checklist records explicitly linked to this View or Topic. The current renderer displays source notes; evidence submission and review states are not implemented.

📌 Meeting headlines.what: Decisions and next actions from this Job’s meeting notes. When the Job also has Tasks, meeting headlines remain separate from Task result headlines.

✍️ Answers to write or agree.what: The Block's Questions whose answer is drafted but not yet written or agreed by a person.
✍️ Answers to write or agree.outcome: You see which answers wait for you and open each to write or agree it.
✍️ Answers to write or agree.layout_detail: One row per Question, its state on the right.
✍️ Answers to write or agree.example: Estimates: answer drafted from j02, waits for you.

📝 Rounds.what: Each round of a collaboration Task's document: what was sent, what came back, and when.
📝 Rounds.outcome: You see the newest round first and what changed since the last one.
📝 Rounds.layout_detail: One row per round, newest first.
📝 Rounds.example: v2 sent 11-04, answers all six comments on v1.

🧪 Runs.what: The Task's Runs and where each stands: done, waiting or failed.
🧪 Runs.outcome: You see how far the Task got and open a Run's receipt.
🧪 Runs.layout_detail: One row per Run with its state.

🧩 Work Block.what: A Block that carries out work and returns results.

📐 Blueprint Block.what: A Block that develops and checks a theme’s pages and supporting skills.
📐 Blueprint Block.layout: Overview · Status · Findings · Delivery · Block UI · Job UI · Task UI

📋 Run Type × View Button.what: Compare what one Run page shows, the same for every theme.

📌 What happened.what: Its headline, its state and when it ran, and its failure if it failed.
📌 What happened.outcome: One line that says what the Run found or why it stopped.

📊 What it made.what: Everything in its result/, the report first, each file drawn as what it is.
📊 What it made.outcome: Open a report, a table, a figure or a map without leaving the page.

🎫 How it ran.what: Its run.yaml in words, its ticket and its config; each path it reads or writes is a link.
🎫 How it ran.outcome: See exactly what ran and rerun it.

🔁 Passes.what: Each pass of the Run, newest first, with the last lines of its log.
🔁 Passes.outcome: See how many times it ran and how the last one ended.
